card.text: Explore Juliet through its published prolate shape model.

introduction.text: Juliet is an elongated inner moon of Uranus, discovered by Voyager 2. Its long axis is modeled as pointing toward the planet.

model.title: Approximate shape model
model.summary: A 150 × 74 × 74 km shape estimate from Voyager. Two axes are assumed equal; gray grid: no surface imagery.
